Subject: MAP: Procurement kickoff — Ariba/Coupa vendor setup & W-9

Hi Sarah / Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap and a proposed MAP for the procurement/onboarding milestones we discussed attached (Zetta-MAP-Draft-20260502.pdf). Please see the milestone table below and tell me if any dates or owners look off.

High-level MAP (vendor onboarding milestones):
- Milestone 1 — Ariba/Coupa vendor registration opened (owner: Zetta procurement) — target: 2026-05-10
- Milestone 2 — W-9 + tax docs uploaded (owner: Zetta procurement) — target: 2026-05-11
- Milestone 3 — Banking details + ACH setup submitted (owner: Zetta procurement) — target: 2026-05-13
- Milestone 4 — PO issued & contract countersigned (owner: Zetta procurement + Redwood legal) — target: 2026-05-20 (target close)
- Milestone 5 — Technical onboarding + sandbox keys (owner: Redwood onboarding) — target: 2026-05-25

Dependencies / notes:
- Procurement systems (Ariba vs Coupa): Sarah mentioned Ariba is primary; if Coupa is required we will provide the alternate vendor packet.
- Security evidence: we'll provide SOC2 summary, privacy addendum and a brief questionnaire — these should not block PO but may be requested before production access.
- Finance: Redwood will accept PO + DocuSign signature; we can issue first invoice upon countersignature.

Requested next steps:
1) Procurement contact to confirm which portal (Ariba vs Coupa) and provide any vendor registration links or requisites.
2) Upload W-9 and banking details to the vendor portal or send securely to procurement@redwoodinference.com if preferred.
3) Confirm PO timeline so we can schedule onboarding resources.

Attachments: Zetta-MAP-Draft-20260502.pdf; Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week if I haven’t heard back.

Best,

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We use Ariba for most vendor onboarding; Tom (cc'd) runs our vendor ops and will kick off the registration. If Ariba prompts for a bank routing/ACH format we can handle that there.
- Procurement will need a completed W-9 (we prefer a PDF uploaded to the portal).
- For tax/contracting we may have additional vendor questionnaire items — I will route to our security team if they look necessary.

One small ask: can Redwood provide a pre-filled vendor packet (company legal name, EIN, W-9 template, remit-to info) to speed the Ariba registration? If you can send that we’ll start immediately.

Also: expected vendor onboarding timeline on our side is typically 7-10 business days after registration submission — hope that aligns.

Subject: Internal: Zetta MAP / ask for onboarding credit approval

Marissa — quick internal note following the procurement kickoff with Zetta Health. Procurement expects ~7 business days for Ariba processing which pushes technical onboarding beyond our original target. To reduce time-to-value I recommend offering a 30-day onboarding credit (service credit) to cover the first month in case of portal delays; this is a common concession for mid-market deals and helps remove friction.

Key context:
- Deal: RDW-2026-ZETTA-57, ARR profile looks healthy, likely to scale quickly after pilot.
- External timeline: PO + contract by 2026-05-20 is still the MAP target; portal processing may extend that by 5-7 business days.
- Ask: approve up to $5k onboarding credit (one-time, applied to first invoice) so we can enable sandbox access earlier and run the pilot pending PO.

If approved I will include the credit in the MAP note and confirm with Sarah/Tom. If you want legal to sign off on the credit terms I can loop them in — Connor, please advise if we need legal pre-approval.

Thanks,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
